sections.content: Use lo, la, los and las with common verbs for giving, buying and receiving. The pronoun replaces the direct object: Compré el regalo → Lo compré. Recibieron las flores → Las recibieron. Keep the pronoun before the conjugated pretérito indefinido verb.

items.spanish: Compré el regalo y lo envolví.
items.english: I bought the gift and wrapped it.

items.spanish: Preparé la tarjeta y la di.
items.english: I prepared the card and gave it.

items.spanish: Recibieron las flores y las guardaron.
items.english: They received the flowers and put them away.

items.spanish: Elegimos los regalos y los compramos.
items.english: We chose the gifts and bought them.

sections.content: Choose the pronoun from the object being replaced: el regalo → lo, la tarjeta → la, los regalos → los, las flores → las.
